purpose: Extend the supported standing-variation filter to trait-specific mutation supply, mutational effect size and pleiotropic coupling while keeping the ecological Model 3 operator unchanged.
biological_question: When standing variation is similarly depleted, can differences in mutational accessibility and pleiotropic coupling alone determine which syndrome components appear first, lag, or evolve together?
primary_endpoints: time to first sustained 0.05 change in access
time to first sustained 0.05 change in investment
fraction of trajectories with only one trait crossing threshold
predeclared_predictions: Under investment_accessible mutation supply, investment reaches its sustained response threshold earlier relative to access than under equal mutation supply.
Under access_accessible mutation supply, access reaches its sustained response threshold earlier relative to investment than under equal mutation supply.

Under right4, where the standing-variation pilot showed access and investment moving in the same positive direction, stronger positive pleiotropic coupling reduces the crossing-time gap and/or increases coordinated two-trait crossing relative to independent mutation.

Under left4, where the standing-variation pilot showed access decreasing while investment increased, stronger positive pleiotropic coupling acts as an antagonistic genetic constraint and increases the crossing-time gap and/or reduces coordinated two-trait crossing relative to independent mutation.

The sign of ecological selection remains determined by the unchanged Model 3 reproductive operator; mutation accessibility changes realization speed and completeness rather than redefining the ecological optimum.
scientific_role: Test whether syndrome-like coordination or decoupling can emerge from the genetic accessibility layer after ecological routes have been separated.
claim_boundary: Mutation rates and effect sizes are synthetic accessibility contrasts, not natural estimates.
No claim that colour corresponds exactly to investment or morphology exactly to access.
No universal claim that pigmentation is genetically simple or architecture genetically complex.
Pleiotropy parameter is a generic mutational covariance, not a mapped molecular network.
Any literal anthocyanin, corolla-tube or developmental-pathway interpretation requires external genetic evidence.

threshold_definition.first_sustained_crossing: first year beginning a run of 20 consecutive annual trait means whose absolute deviation from that trajectory's initial mean is at least 0.05
threshold_definition.coordinated_crossing: both traits achieve sustained crossing and their first sustained crossing years differ by at most 20 years
threshold_definition.single_trait_crossing: exactly one trait achieves sustained crossing by year 400

mutation_kernel.unit: each transmitted diploid allele copy after Mendelian segregation and before recruitment
mutation_kernel.marginal_rate_preservation: access and investment retain their declared per-copy mutation probabilities exactly
mutation_kernel.coupling_semantics: pleiotropy value p is the fraction of the maximum possible shared mutation-event rate: shared_rate = p * min(mu_access, mu_investment); access_only = mu_access - shared_rate; investment_only = mu_investment - shared_rate
mutation_kernel.shared_effect: a shared event applies the same standard-normal deviate to access and investment, scaled by each trait's declared mutation SD, giving positive effect-direction coupling
mutation_kernel.independent_effect: trait-only events use independent standard-normal deviates
mutation_kernel.boundaries: mutated allele values are reflected into [0,1] using the same reflection rule as Model 3

decision_rule.mutation_accessibility_supported_if: the accessible-trait mutation regime shifts the median paired crossing-time difference in its preregistered direction relative to equal mutation supply in at least one visitor history, with the other history reported regardless of sign
decision_rule.context_dependent_pleiotropy_supported_i: strong_positive versus independent mutation changes coordination in opposite preregistered directions between right4 (facilitating aligned change) and left4 (constraining antagonistic change)
decision_rule.reporting: report every cell and paired founder×demographic trajectory; no outcome-dependent cell dropping except extinction, which remains an explicit outcome
